title: 💠 Strait of Hormuz- October 30th --  a supertanker exploded after hitting a naval mine in an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz.
text:
💠 Strait of Hormuz- October 30th --  a supertanker exploded after hitting a naval mine in an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz."

"**IRGC Navy Public Relations Office:**"

"🔹 This is the third tanker to explode and catch fire because it was passing through an unauthorized route."

"🔹 This supertanker, carrying more than 2 million barrels of oil, has been abandoned at the mouth of the Strait of Hormuz and is burning."

"Source: IRGC
